content: While memory and storage prices are still high, there are still good discounts on other gaming-related hardware. Take Alienware’s AW2726DM, for example. Dell is selling it for $319.99, a $30 break from the usual price of $349.99. The 27-inch gaming monitor features an QD-OLED panel for deep, immersive black levels, and quantum dots for full and vivid colors. With a 240Hz refresh rate for super smooth gaming, and AMD FreeSync Premium Plus to keep your frames per second and refresh rate locked together, this monitor is a great, budget-friendly choice for PC gamers who don’t want to compromise on contrast and fast response times. [Product: Alienware AW2726DM QD-OLED monitor | https://www.anrdoezrs.net/links/8836598/type/dlg/https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/alienware-27-240hz-qd-oled-gaming-monitor-aw2726dm/apd/210-bvrc/monitors-monitor-accessories] Connectivity is a bit limited, with a DisplayPort 1.4 port that supports up to 240Hz at 2560 x 1440, and two HDMI ports that support up to 120Hz at its peak resolution. While some other screens have USB hubs or audio connections, they aren’t necessary for PC gaming, and sometimes add to the cost. The included stand has adjustable swivel, height, pivot, and tilt, with a 100 x 100 VESA mount in case you want to mount it to a monitor arm or use a different stand. It also sports a lengthy three year warranty with coverage for burn-in. Read our Alienware AW2726DM hands-on.

chineseContent: 虽然内存和存储价格仍然很高，但其他游戏相关硬件仍然有不错的折扣。以 Alienware 的 AW2726DM 为例。戴尔的售价为 319.99 美元，比平常的 349.99 美元价格低了 30 美元。这款 27 英寸游戏显示器采用 QD-OLED 面板，可呈现深沉、身临其境的黑电平，并采用量子点，呈现饱满、鲜艳的色彩。这款显示器具有 240Hz 刷新率，可实现超流畅的游戏体验，而 AMD FreeSync Premium Plus 可将每秒帧数和刷新率保持在一起，对于不想在对比度和快速响应时间上妥协的 PC 游戏玩家来说，这是一个经济实惠的绝佳选择。 [产品：Alienware AW2726DM QD-OLED 显示器 | https://www.anrdoezrs.net/links/8836598/type/dlg/https://www.dell.com/en-us/shop/alienware-27-240hz-qd-oled-gaming-monitor-aw2726dm/apd/210-bvrc/monitors-monitor-accessories] 连接性有点有限，支持 DisplayPort 1.4 端口2560 x 1440 时高达 240Hz，两个 HDMI 端口在峰值分辨率下支持高达 120Hz。虽然其他一些屏幕具有 USB 集线器或音频连接，但它们对于 PC 游戏来说并不是必需的，有时还会增加成本。随附的支架具有可调节的旋转、高度、枢轴和倾斜度，并配有 100 x 100 VESA 安装架，以防您想将其安装到显示器臂或使用不同的支架。它还拥有长达三年的保修期，包括老化保修。阅读我们的 Alienware AW2726DM 实践。
